summary: The filing is an 8-K reporting ReposiTrak, Inc.'s declaration of a quarterly cash dividend of $0.02 per share ($0.08 annualized) payable on/around August 14, 2026 to holders of record June 30, 2026. The dividend is funded from the company's cash flows. No board recommendation or advisor is named. The mechanics are a regular quarterly cash distribution; no special dividend or buyback is indicated. The registrant is the issuer. This is a routine capital return event, not a special situation, though it involves return of capital to shareholders. What to watch: sustainability of the dividend payout relative to earnings and cash flows.
